name: demoshop-platform
description: E-Commerce Storefront with integrated PocketBase server and standalone Admin CMS

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix storefront install && npm --prefix admin-cms install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "STORE,ADMIN,PB" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm run dev:store" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:pb"
scripts.build: npm --prefix storefront run build && npm --prefix admin-cms run build
